issues.issue: Should the cessation hearing be re-opened because the applicant was not notified and so had no chance to answer the allegations (breach of natural justice)?
issues.applicant_position: She got no notice of the cessation hearing, which went ahead without her, and she applied once she learned of it.
issues.respondent_position: Opposed the re-opening application; the reasons for opposition are not stated in the decision.
issues.result_quote: the panel will allow the application to re-open the cessation hearing.
